description: LuaJIT virtual machine manipulation, including bytecode patching and engine call interception.

functions.name: patch_bytecodes
functions.description:
Patches several LuaJIT bytecode handlers for this VM state to LJE-aware versions. Specifically:

- `ISEQV` / `ISNEV` — patched to use spoof-aware equality comparisons, since the default fast-path breaks for spoofed functions.
- `TGETS` — patched to block or remap metatable lookups when LJE remaps are active.
- `CALLT` / `CALLMT` — patched to support tail-call interception.

Also flushes all JIT traces before patching. Should be called once during initialization.
functions.note: You do not need to ever call this. LJE automatically calls it at preinit.

functions.name: set_engine_call_hook
functions.description: Registers a Lua function to be called when the engine invokes a hooked function. The callback is automatically marked as special and stored per-script. Requires an active script context. Only one hook can be active per script at a time.
functions.note: Any engine call hook that handles the call first will suppress it from reaching any other engine call hook.

params.name: fn
params.description: Must be a Lua function, not a C function.

errors: Argument 1 must be a Lua function (not a C function).

functions.name: handle_engine_call
functions.description:
Marks the current engine call as handled. Call this from within an engine call hook to signal that LJE should not perform its default handling for this call.

After calling this function, return any values that should be returned to the engine. If you don't, the engine may get confused and explode.
```lua
lje.vm.handle_engine_call()
return value1, value2, ...
```
